claim.routeClaimReason: no run reached 6 AM; this record measures the hall flash per cycle on three traced nights and prices where the hall tap can move in the model

instrument.method: mean luma of the 20x9 grid cells covering PixelWatch.java FOXY_HALL (1650,300 450x400: cols 13-17, rows 2-5), read only on frames whose button strokes read office, in a window around each scheduled hallLight contact on the clock-bracket midpoint
instrument.litSignature: two frames at luma ~45 starting 20-40 ms after the 33 ms tap; dark reads 0-3
instrument.videoCrossCheck: ffmpeg crop of the same rectangle scaled to the 1280x576 recording (880,160 240x213), 60 fps, spikes of 1-5 frames >= 15 over the trailing-second median: on night5-contact200a every +52..56 two-frame spike falls at hall-tap time and the lit/dark set per cycle matches the trace census one for one (attempt 1: 15 lit; attempt 2: 7 lit)
instrument.caveat: DARK is an upper bound on refused flashes: the dump says the light stays on during hall movement (group 202 renders animation 99), which renders dark

census.note: 16 hall taps before the death at +185.2 s; lit at video 38.7, 58.7 ... 178.7, dark at 28.7, 48.7, 118.7, 168.7

mechanism.engine: packages/core/src/mechanics/plant-model.js maskFullyOff / hallLightOn: every office light is gated on mask == 0, and mask off is the END of the mask-off animation, not the press ("the post-mask flash lockout IS that animation")
mechanism.plan: the loop hall tap is at +9500, 300 ms after the mask-off press at +9200; MASK_ANIM_OFF is ~244 ms, so the tap clears the lockout by ~56 ms in the model
mechanism.device: per-contact actuation latency is bracketed at 30-110 ms (stated, unmeasured); the 200 ms mask-off hold raised the dark rate from 40% to 58-61%, measured, mechanism not derived

modelSweep.reading: moving the hall tap 100-400 ms later costs nothing in the model on nights 1, 2, 5, 6 and 7; a later offset buys the lockout the slack the mistake register demands. Not bound, not tested on device.

deaths.deliveredEpochMs: 94.9 +- 33.1 (phase-reconstruct with the native trace), 21.7 ms outside the [116.67,166.67) puppet band, inconclusive
deaths.modelInsideThatBand: puppet deaths at 27.7-107.7 s (3000 seeds), never near 372 s
deaths.hypothesis: Foxy through a dark hall; no cause model fired -- a hypothesis, not a finding

deaths.evidence: the gate at +185200 read a screen with no stroke signature (grid luma 36) on all five reads from +185.2 s; static observed at +187.1 s; the gate-abort at +188.3 s is the consequence of the death, not its cause
deaths.maskWindows: every latched mask window 4.58 s on the video (grade-minus7.py), uniform
deaths.hypothesis: the death lands on the cycle edge where the monitor lowers and the mask rises, which is where the model puts an unevicted Mangle; consistent with the shared five-tick budget at a losing epoch, i.e. the model's own uncontrolled-epoch loss (1233-1375/3000). Pedro watched the run and reported mask time insufficient to repel Mangle.

openLimits: the hall grader reads a rendered flash; a refused flash and a flash rendered dark by hall movement are not separated
the clock bracket is 80 ms after schedule anchoring, under stated latency bounds
n=1 per death; neither death has an instrument-named cause
